title: Restore extraction coverage for gfp::specialized batch_*_mersenne31 functions
description:
Restore transparent Charon/Aeneas extraction for the three `gf2_core::gfp::specialized::batch_*_mersenne31` functions, which were marked `--opaque` during the toolchain upgrade (issue 150d7d79) because the upgraded Aeneas Std (0f99a049) no longer ships the slice-iterator `.zip` instances they extract to.

## Background

During the Charon `e069223a` / Aeneas `0f99a049` toolchain upgrade (150d7d79), `scripts/verify-lean.sh` was changed to `--opaque` three functions:

- `gf2_core::gfp::specialized::batch_mul_mersenne31`
- `gf2_core::gfp::specialized::batch_mul_add_mersenne31`
- `gf2_core::gfp::specialized::batch_dot_mersenne31`

Each uses `acc.iter_mut().zip(a.iter().zip(b.iter()))`-style iterator chains. The previous Aeneas (5fc8fdf2) translated those slice `.zip` iterator instances; 0f99a049 does not, so they extracted to `Unknown constant ...IteratorIteratorSharedAT.zip`. They were extracted transparently before the upgrade but **no theorem ever targeted them** (they are batch SIMD helpers, not proof targets), so the upgrade lost no proof/theorem coverage - only extraction transparency of three un-proven functions. The user explicitly accepted this delta for 150d7d79 and asked to revisit it here.

## Possible approaches (to be evaluated)

1. Reproduce the dropped slice-`.zip` iterator instances as project-local `FunsExternal`/Std definitions so the functions translate again.
2. Rewrite the three functions in `crates/gf2-core/src/gfp/specialized.rs` to use index-based loops instead of iterator `.zip` (extracts natively; touches production source, needs its own tests).
3. Wait for / contribute an upstream Aeneas fix that restores slice-`.zip` iterator translation, then drop the `--opaque` lines.

Investigate feasibility/cost of each and pick one. If a correctness proof for these batch kernels is also desired, state that as a separate deliverable.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] The three `batch_*_mersenne31` functions are no longer `--opaque` in `scripts/verify-lean.sh` (or an explicit, user-approved decision is recorded that transparent extraction is infeasible and they stay opaque permanently, with the reason).
- [ ] [hard] `scripts/verify-lean.sh` runs end-to-end clean (verify-lean gate) and `lake build` is green with no new `sorry` (lake-build gate) after the change.
- [ ] [hard] No regression to the proofs that already pass under 150d7d79's trio.
- [ ] [hard] The chosen approach is documented (design note attached via `jit doc add`), including why the other approaches were rejected.
